common: Use case: stylized-concept. Lumia Chronicles original warm academic classical fantasy game asset. Fine hand drawn ink outlines, soft watercolor and colored pencil matte texture, cream parchment, sage green, restrained coral and antique brass, quiet turquoise rune light. Cohesive readable game art, no logos, no words, no letters, no UI text, no watermark, no scenery unless specifically a tile/backdrop, no border unless requested. No photorealism, plastic 3D, neon, excessive ornate gold. One asset only. Full object visible, clean contour, appropriate breathing room. Transparent background when requested, fully opaque object interiors except intentional glass/glow.
